summary: Enhance your skills in agribusiness with our comprehensive development and management training course. Join us to cultivate your future in agriculture.
lede: Agribusiness development training helps agriculture professionals and entrepreneurs plan and manage agricultural ventures as businesses. Participants learn to develop business models and budgets, assess markets and risks, and strengthen value chains through financing and value addition. The syllabus also covers climate-smart sustainability and pitching proposals to banks, donors, and investors.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals and organizations involved in agriculture, agribusiness, and development. It is tailored for:
audience: Value chain and supply chain managers
Corporate strategy consultants in the food
modules: Costing and Financial Management in Agribusiness
